183: And Jacob lived, etc.: Rabbi Chiya opened and said, "And your people, all of them righteous, shall possess the land for all time, etc. (Isaiah 60:21) — fortunate is the Jewish people, more than all of the idolatrous nations. For the Holy One, blessed be He called them righteous, to bequeath them the inheritance of worlds in the world to come, in order that they delight in that world. It is as it is written, Then you shall delight in the Lord (Isaiah 58:14). What is the reason? Because they cling to the body of the King, as it is writtenwhile you, who cling to the Lord your God, are all alive today (Deuteronomy 4:4)."
